decoding_verification.method: PIL Image.open(...).load() full decode on every extracted file during extraction, then a second independent re-open + full decode pass over all 5199 files on disk during audit (audit file per generator group reports n_images_verified_decoding == n_images_declared).

documented_vs_unknown_generators.note: Generator MODEL is documented for every synthetic image. For Midjourney the ARCHITECTURE is not documented by anyone and is recorded as Unknown_Architecture - Midjourney's architecture has never been publicly disclosed. That is an honest unknown, not a fabricated label.

duplicate_overlap_existing_corpus.method: exact = SHA256 of file bytes; perceptual = 64-bit dHash (8x8 DCT-free horizontal comparison) over all 12807 existing corpus images + all new images.
duplicate_overlap_existing_corpus.interpretation: Essentially ZERO overlap with the existing corpus. The single perceptual match is a dHash collision on a low-texture ImageNet photo, not a shared image.

synthetic.note: synthetic images have no 'real_source'; this row records that generator identity is documented for all 4299 while their real counterparts' corpora are not.

within_new_source.verdict: NOT source-confounded. Real images come from MULTIPLE distinct real corpora (at least ImageNet-val plus 498 from other, unnamed real pools such as LSUN/CelebA/ADE20K-style corpora), not from one source. And every synthetic image has a documented generator.

across_whole_corpus.verdict: Each class draws from MULTIPLE sources, so a source-confounded split (all real from source X, all synthetic from source Y) is AVOIDABLE by construction here - but MUST still be checked explicitly at split time, not assumed.

CLASS_X_SOURCE_CONTINGENCY.residual_confound_to_watch: Within the new source, GAN/ProGAN/StyleGAN/GauGAN/WhichFaceIsReal real images plausibly come from those generators' OWN training distributions. That is intended by a forensics benchmark and it means a model CAN learn 'LSUN/CelebA texture' rather than 'synthesis'. The control is to hold the GENERATOR out and keep the real pool fixed, not to assume the real pool is neutral.

SHORTCUT_RISK_resolution_x_class_within_.verdict: PARTIALLY CONFOUNDED - read before using this source. Within the new source, synthetic images are almost entirely 256x256 PNG while a large share of real images are larger variable-resolution JPEG. A detector could exploit resolution/format instead of synthesis artefacts. Any evaluation MUST control for resolution (e.g. centre-crop/resize all images to a common size) and must report JPEG-vs-PNG as a controlled factor.

reasoning: The new source contributes 8 documented GAN generators (1959 images) and 3 documented non-Latent pixel-space diffusion generators - ADM, GLIDE, VQDM (780 images) - plus SDXL and DALLE2. That is 6 architecture families genuinely absent from the existing corpus, where 99.3% of synthetic images are LatDiff fine-tunes.
Every synthetic image's generator comes from a source metadata column, so generator-held-out folds are label-truthful rather than filename-guessed.
Real images are available as a single pool that is not tied to one corpus, so a source-controlled design (fixed real pool, hold out generator family) is constructible.
Caveat: only 6 of 60 shards were obtained (~32 GB total release), so per-generator counts are uneven (ProGAN 139 vs 260 elsewhere). This affects balance, not label validity.
